quote: Featuring an 11‑metre pedestal and reinforced hydraulic systems, the latest unit offers an exceptional lifting capacity of 80 tonnes at an 18‑metre outreach. The crane operates with an electro-hydraulic drive that produces no emissions at the port… Delivery is scheduled for Q3 2026, timed to support the terminal’s expansion programme.
note: Opened Liebherr English company primary 2026-10-04; 80 t/18 m / Q3 2026 delivery / electro-hydraulic confirmed; CapEx undisclosed.
